title: Sauna Rental (With or Without Herbal Hot Tub)

baltaPirts.title: White Sauna
baltaPirts.description: The right choice for larger groups, with plenty of seating and nature all around. Ideal for family and friends' celebrations.

pelekaPirts.title: Grey Sauna
pelekaPirts.description: Designed by the sauna master himself for sauna rituals, with benches of just the right width and height.

herbTub.title: Herbal Hot Tub
herbTub.description: Add a herbal hot tub with fragrant medicinal plants: pine needles in winter, birch and oak leaves in summer.

interlude.alt: Two wooden saunas at the forest edge: the large log sauna with wide windows and the small dark sauna with its chimney and woodpile.
